runs.purpose: same-group grandchild keeps stdout open after the child exits
argv:
import os, sys, time
pid = os.fork()
if pid == 0:
    open(sys.argv[1], "w").write(str(os.getpid()))
    time.sleep(30)
    os._exit(0)
time.sleep(0.3)
print("parent done", flush=True)

import os, sys, time, signal
if sys.argv[2] == "ignore-term":
    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, signal.SIG_IGN)
pid = os.fork()
if pid == 0:
    open(sys.argv[1], "w").write(str(os.getpid()))
    time.sleep(60)
    os._exit(0)
time.sleep(60)

runs.purpose: descendant leaves the process group (setsid) and keeps stdout open
argv:
import os, sys, time
pid = os.fork()
if pid == 0:
    os.setsid()
    open(sys.argv[1], "w").write(str(os.getpid()))
    time.sleep(20)
    os._exit(0)
time.sleep(0.3)
